name: VaultLama
description: Open-source Vaultwarden password manager for phones, tablets, desktops and browsers. Calm midnight chrome, secrets that stay masked until asked, and one midnight-violet accent for intent.

sans.css: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", Roboto, Cantarell, "Noto Sans", sans-serif
sans.note: Platform face (SF Pro, Segoe UI Variable, Roboto, Cantarell or Noto Sans): a password manager should feel like part of the system it fills into.

mono.note: Bundled with meridian_ui. Revealed passwords, generated passwords, one-time codes and fingerprints, always with tabular figures so similar glyphs stay apart.

signature: Midnight islands on a cool ground; secrets masked until the person asks, revealed in mono and re-masked on their own; one midnight-violet accent for intent. Danger, warning and attention keep their status meaning for weak, reused and exposed credentials.
